best_reason: D has the strongest hierarchy and craft: clear title/header, dominant threshold control, coherent grouped dynamics/output sections, legible values, restrained spacing, and a believable compressor-focused layout without obvious clipping.

A: Bottom mix strip is clipped/partially off-canvas
Right-side controls feel disconnected from main threshold area
Hierarchy is clean but sparse and somewhat unfinished
Some labels/values are small relative to available space
B: White frame/card treatment fights the dark compressor aesthetic
Multiple controls appear cramped or inconsistently inset
Tiny knob labels overlap visually inside white boxes
Bottom makeup strip is clipped off-canvas
Hierarchy is noisy and less coherent
C: Central threshold area is clear but surrounding modules feel boxy and uneven
Some labels are very small and low contrast
Top-right meter is decorative but weakly integrated
Bottom stereo link/ink text reads like unfinished placeholders
Control spacing is serviceable but not polished
D: Does not approach the aspirational visual richness of the Halo reference
Main threshold glow is a bit heavy compared with otherwise restrained styling
Right panels are competent but slightly generic
Large empty space could be used more intentionally
